report_policy.core_research_question: Does the GPT-2 Large finding (layer-0 embedding L2 distance D between ' big' and token B does not visibly predict interpolation transition width W; final layer sharper than middle layer; W_final one broad peak with tail) generalize to GPT2-XL, Pythia 1.4B, Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-8B-Base?

checklist.request: Can you check if the study can be generalized to GPT2-XL, Pythia 1.4B, Llama-3.1-8B，Qwen3-8B-Base

completion.what_was_done: Re-ran the full GPT-2 Large study (prompt 'The house was big', ' big' -> every other token, 101 interpolation steps, W at middle and final block) on GPT2-XL (50,256 tokens), Pythia 1.4B (50,276), Llama-3.1-8B (128,255; weights from ungated mirror unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B) and Qwen3-8B-Base (151,668). Full vocabularies, 8B models unquantized bf16 with float32 residual stream; precision checked (median |dW_final| 0.002-0.003).
completion.evidence: REPORT_generalization.md (Summary, Methods, Results sections 'GPT2-XL', 'Pythia 1.4B', 'Llama-3.1-8B', 'Qwen3-8B-Base', Figures 1-12); RESULTS_generalization.md G0-G4; results/gen/<model>.csv, results/gen/<model>_summary.json; experiments/gen_common.py, gen_sweep.py, gen_plots.py.

completion.evidence: REPORT_generalization.md section 'Conclusion — does the trend generalize?' (comparison table + paragraphs); RESULTS_generalization.md G5.

routing_notes: Interpretations that are NOT blocking (recorded for the next pass): 'figure 1-3' = REPORT.md Figures 1-3 = plots/fig1_distance_vs_width.png (D vs W scatter, middle and final block), plots/fig1_zoom_distance_vs_width.png (zoom D 1.6-3.3), plots/fig2_final_width_distribution.png (W_final histogram + sorted view). 'S4 tabele' = the W_final band table in RESULTS.md section S4 (band, token count, lowest-D examples). 'the part of the table that corresponding to W 0.3' = the '0.30-0.50' W_final band row (the only band containing 0.3), per model. Per-model adaptation: same prompt 'The house was big' with A = that model's ' big' token, B = every other vocabulary id, 101 steps, readouts at the middle block (n_layers/2, analogous to GPT-2 Large block 18 of 36) and the final block (pre final norm), same W and flag definitions. Existing GPT-2 Large results stay unchanged. OPERATOR ROUTING (PLAN.md, 2026-09-28): sections + final synthesis -> REPORT_generalization.md (up to 12 main figures); detailed results -> RESULTS_generalization.md; GPT-2 Large REPORT.md/RESULTS.md unchanged. GPU: per-agent budget is now 0.45 x 31.9 GB = 14.4 GB. 8B models are run UNMODIFIED in their native bf16 weights: prefix keys/values are computed once and only the last position is run; transformer blocks that do not fit on the GPU are copied from CPU memory block-by-block (exact computation, no quantization). This was option (c) of the earlier ambiguity and does not change the model studied. Llama-3.1-8B: the official repo is gated and no HF token exists here; weights are taken from the ungated mirror unsloth/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B (same base-model weights), stated in the report. Pythia: EleutherAI/pythia-1.4b (default). Zoom panel (Figure 2 analogue): GPT-2 Large used D 1.6-3.3; for each new model the zoom range is that model's 5th-95th D percentile.
